description: Controlled vocabulary defining fiber types used in the material_batches tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

entries.definition: Fiber reinforcement composed of glass fibers.
Fiber reinforcement composed of natural fibers such as plant-, mineral-, or animal-derived fibers.
Fiber reinforcement composed of polyethylene fibers.
Macrofiber reinforcement composed of polypropylene fibers.
Microfiber reinforcement composed of polypropylene fibers.
Fiber reinforcement composed of polyvinyl alcohol fibers.
Fiber reinforcement composed of recycled polymeric materials.
Steel fiber reinforcement with crimped geometry.
Steel fiber reinforcement with hooked ends.
Hybrid steel fiber reinforcement, typically involving more than one steel fiber geometry, size, or type.
Steel fiber reinforcement with straight geometry.
Steel fiber reinforcement with twisted geometry.
Fiber type that does not fall within the predefined categories.
Fiber type not reported or not identifiable from the available documentation.
